risks: IR enrichment breaks downstream code. Mitigation: Use additive fields and compatibility constructors; land with focused regression tests.
completion_notes: Centralized the previously-scattered 'BC name == mesh boundary tag' assumption on the IR. New ProblemIR.required_region_tags() and ProblemIR.derived_mesh_contract() helpers expose a single source of truth that downstream layers can read. New solver.mesh_io.validate_mesh_against_contract() bridges MeshContract ↔ HexMesh.boundary_tags so the IR/mesh mismatch surfaces as BoundaryRegionError at the boundary instead of a deep KeyError in codegen / runtime. Conservative regression scope — no signature changes to lowering / codegen / boundary_codegen public surfaces. 12/12 tests pass; full mechdsl-core suite at 1511 pass / 0 fail (80 skipped, 110 deselected for slow/gpu/e2e markers).
